faqs.q: What is the current governor general salary?

faqs.q: How does the national minimum wage compare to the governor general salary?
faqs.a: From 1 July 2026, the national minimum wage is $26.44 per hour, or $1004.90 per week for 38 hours. Casual employees receive a 25% loading, making it $33.05 per hour. The governor general salary is over 13 times the annual minimum wage.

faqs.q: How do I convert my hourly rate to an annual salary?

bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding the Governor General Salary and Your Own Pay

### The Governor General Salary: A Benchmark

The Governor-General's salary is set by the Governor-General Act 1974 at $709,017 per year. This figure provides a useful benchmark for understanding the vast range of earnings in Australia, from the national minimum wage to executive salaries. While few Australians earn at this level, it highlights the importance of knowing your own hourly or annual rate and how it compares to official standards.

### Converting Hourly Rates to Annual Pay

Most Australian employees are paid by the hour or on a salary. To compare, use the formula: annual gross ≈ hourly rate × hours per week × 52. We assume a standard 38-hour week for full-time work, as this is the ordinary hours basis used by the Fair Work Commission for the national minimum wage. For example, the national minimum wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour, giving $1004.90 per week and $52,254.80 per year. Casual employees receive a 25% loading, making it $33.05 per hour, or $65,318.50 annually.

### Fortnightly Pay

Many employers pay fortnightly. Multiply the weekly amount by 2. For the minimum wage, that's $2009.80 per fortnight before tax. For a casual on the minimum, it's $2512.25 per fortnight. Knowing your fortnightly figure helps with budgeting and comparing salary offers.

### Award Rates and Casual Loading

Award rates are higher than the minimum wage for many industries. The Fair Work Ombudsman provides pay guides for each award, which include minimum pay rates, allowances, and penalty rates. Casual loading of 25% is paid on top of the base rate for casual employees. Our [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) tool helps you calculate your annual equivalent. Remember, when using the timesheet on the home page, enter your base hourly rate without casual loading; the checkbox adds the 25% on top.

### Superannuation

Super guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top of your salary. It stops at the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year. For the minimum wage, super adds $6,270.58 per year. For the governor general salary, super would be capped at $32,499.60 (12% of $270,830) because the salary exceeds the base. Super is not deducted from your pay; it is an additional contribution by your employer.

### Tax

Using the 2026–27 resident tax scale: tax-free threshold $18,200, then 15% to $45,000, 30% to $135,000, 37% to $190,000, 45% above. Medicare levy of 2% applies. For the minimum wage earner ($52,254.80), tax is approximately $5,092 plus Medicare $1,045, leaving about $46,118 after tax. For the governor general salary, tax would be substantial: $18,200 tax-free, then $4,020 (15% on $26,800), $27,000 (30% on $90,000), $20,350 (37% on $55,000), and $233,557.65 (45% on $519,017) = total tax $284,927.65 plus Medicare $14,180.34, leaving about $409,909 after tax.

### Comparing to Average Earnings

ABS Average Weekly Earnings (May 2026) for full-time adult ordinary time is $2,083.70 per week, or $108,352.40 annually. All employees total earnings average $1,579.20 per week ($82,118.40 annually). The governor general salary is over 6.5 times the full-time average. This comparison shows the wide dispersion of earnings in Australia and why understanding your own pay relative to benchmarks is valuable.

### Using Our Tools

Our [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) page details current rates and special national minimum wages for juniors, apprentices, and employees with disability. The [timesheet](/) home page lets you enter your hourly rate and optionally add casual loading. You can also explore [pay guides](/blog) for award-specific rates. Remember, never include casual loading in the base rate you enter; the checkbox applies it correctly.

### Disclaimer

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.
